crossRefs.note: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many…
He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard…
They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in…
I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live…
I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is…
Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting…
Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

people.name: Drusilla
people.line: Jewish wife of Felix, the Roman governor

people.name: Felix
people.line: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: But after some days, Felix came with Drusilla, his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
translations.bsb: After several days, Felix returned with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jewess. He sent for Paul and listened to him speak about faith in Christ Jesus.
translations.kjv: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
translations.asv: But after certain days, Felix came with Drusilla, his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
